It consists of a finite set of states, a set of input symbols, a transition function, a start state, and a set of accepting states. The DFA reads an input string and transitions from one state to another based on the current state and the input symbol. We are changing the start state of DFA D to be an accepting state, resulting in a new DFA D'. If the source message contains a tag-value pair that is already present in the destination message, the tag-value pair in the destination message is overwritten with the tag-value pair in the source message.
